colony.speaker: pell
colony.text: Your face just moved. Not the way faces move. What are you?

choices.text: [Swarmborn] A colony. It does that when I am tired. Talk to me anyway.
Nothing you need to worry about.

unnerved.speaker: pell
unnerved.text: Whatever that is behind you, it is not breathing. I have seen not-breathing things down there. Keep it where I can see it.

choices.text: [Hollow] I am the one not breathing, Pell.
It is with me. It stays with me.

greet.speaker: pell
greet.text: Weavers. You're Beacon-crew, I can see the burn on your boots. Halden took us down the second depth and it sang to us. Six of us went in humming. I'm the one who stopped.

choices.text: [Swarmborn] (Your skin holds. She sees a person with burned boots.)
[Keeper] I keep the Beacon that sent Halden down. Say what you need to say to it.
Where is the rest of your crew?
[Undercity] I know that tune. My mother hummed it before the Shard took her.
Sera, she's Ashfound-marked. Yours?

sera_marks.speaker: sera
sera_marks.text: Purge-school. Same as me. Pell, you were on the Ninth Stair detail?

choices.text: Let her answer the crew question first.

crew.speaker: pell
crew.text: In the tower. The drones got them, or the singing did; I stopped being able to tell. Halden kept the log. If you want to know what we heard, it's still on him, past the hive.

choices.text: [Trueborn] Unaltered, like you. The Ashfound like that in a torch. We will get the log.
We'll get the log. Get yourself back to the road.
Kaj-7, is she hearing what you hear?
You stay put until we clear it.

kaj_hears.speaker: kaj7
kaj_hears.text: Yes. It is the same signal. She has less of it than I do. I do not know if that is lucky.

choices.text: Noted. We'll get the log.

after.speaker: pell
after.text: Still humming. Go on. The log is past the hive.

choices.text: Go back to the road, Pell.
Hold on.

crews.speaker: pell
crews.text: You read Halden's slate. Then read this: three more crews went down after us. Ostrand, Vane, Marrow. Beacon-crew, all of them, all humming when they left. Their last positions are on my board. Somebody should go and look, and it is not going to be me.

choices.text: Give me the positions.
Not our crews. Not our problem.

positions.speaker: pell
positions.text: Ostrand went in humming a fifth. Vane took a drone-rig she should not have had. Marrow took the cistern route, the one the Beacon does not map. Find them or find what is left. I will keep the light on here.

choices.text: We'll be back.

hub.speaker: pell
hub.text: Light's on. Three positions, three answers; bring me what you have when you have it.

choices.text: Working on it.
Go home to the Bastion, Pell. Keep the light on from there.
